Technical Procedure
Introduction

This document 
 outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
 every three 
 years as 
 indicated by Y3 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng.Gamal Nady, reviewed by director eng. 
 Anwar Saber Barakat., revised by Mokhtar Abed El Rahman Awad, accepted by 
 general director eng.Abed El Naser Maarof, and 
 approved by eng. Gamal Deiab Head Sector of Assuit Power 
 Station.

Safety 
Precautions

A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes .... etc

The breaker 
 must be isolated from the network and earthed

sections.text: Measuring Test

Measure the 
 insulation resistauce for control circuit between terminal and ground with 500 
 megger which must be 2MΩ or more

Measure the insulation resistance for main circuit 
 between main circuit and gas tank with 1000 v megger which must be 1000 MΩ or 
 more

Check the dis connection of spale heater (C-15) by 
 check the current between the space heater terminals

Check the operation of the oil pump by check the 
 initial oil charging time which must be 10 % from the data obtained last 
 time

Check the time requiered from raising the pressure from 
 315 bar to 335 bar must be 210 sec

Check the accumulator gas (N2) pressure by starting up 
 the pump at zero oil pressure then the pressure rises at stroke from several 
 tens to about 200 bar the pressure which rose in this manner is the gas 
 pressure.
